technique_name: Create a model to predict the demand of local produce in a specific region
description: The model we propose to predict the demand of local produce in a specific region would be based on the historical data of the local produce market in the region. We would consider factors such as the population of the region, local farming industry and other available produce, what seasons the produce is available in, and seasonal climate fluctuations.
